about: Examples of every relay endpoint: request and answer, as test/relay-contract.test.mjs checks them against the real relay. docs/relay-api.md is the contract in words. A string in angle brackets is a placeholder (see placeholders); any other value must match exactly. Objects have exactly the keys shown.
auth: Endpoints marked auth take the header Authorization: Bearer <token> (the session key from /signin/exchange or /signin/poll).

placeholders.<time>: an ISO 8601 time in UTC, like 2026-11-18T12:00:00.000Z
placeholders.<code>: a sign-in code as shown: XXXX-XXXX from ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789
placeholders.<code8>: the same code without the dash
placeholders.<report>: a report id: KR- and 4 symbols of the same alphabet
placeholders.<text>: a sentence for people (may change; do not parse)

Post.title: string
Post.replies: number of replies (not the app's own messages)
Post.unread: replies by others since the player last opened it
Post.lastReply: { name, team (boolean: of the Kiln team), at: <time> } or null

Result.read: { by: team member's name, at: <time> } or null
Result.replied: boolean: a team member replied to it or mentioned the tester

bad-request: the request is malformed; message says what
signed-out: no session, or it ended; sign in again
refused: the verifier, secret or code does not match this sign-in
not-member: not in the Kiln Discord; has invite
too-new: the Discord account is under 3 days old; has retryAt
not-found: no such endpoint, or not your post
waiting: the sign-in is not finished yet
no-test-post: the test build has no #testing post yet
expired: the sign-in expired or was used
too-big: has limit (bytes) and, for a zip part, size
bad-zip: not one of our report zips; has problem
rate-limited: has retryAt and limit (hour, day or network); reports also lastPost
slow-down: has retryAfter (seconds); also the Retry-After header
unavailable: Discord is not answering (or the account is blocked: deliberately the same answer)
busy: too many uploads at once; nothing was used up

endpoints.name: start a desktop sign-in
endpoints.notes: port: the launcher's loopback listener (1024-65535); leave it out when it can't listen, then poll (the player then presses Approve on the page first). device defaults to desktop for browser and deck for qr; version is optional. The launcher opens url in the browser.

endpoints.name: start a Deck sign-in (QR pairing)
endpoints.notes: The Deck shows url as a QR code and code as text; frostdev.io/link takes a typed code.

endpoints.name: too many sign-ins from one network
finish a desktop sign-in with the loopback's one-time code
endpoints.notes: Works once. The loopback handler can then send the browser to https://frostdev.io/kiln/signin/done.

endpoints.name: poll while waiting
endpoints.notes: At most every 2 seconds. A desktop sign-in without a port is collected by the poll (after Approve on the page); with a port only by the exchange, and the poll stays waiting.

endpoints.name: poll after Approve
endpoints.notes: Once: the sign-in is deleted with this answer.

endpoints.name: poll after Decline on the phone
poll after Cancel on Discord's page
poll an expired or unknown sign-in
the account
endpoints.notes: Membership is read from Discord (at most once a minute). When Discord is down the answer adds "stale": true and member is the last known.

endpoints.name: send a report (zip to the team)
endpoints.request: multipart/form-data: draft (JSON) {"title":"Mods don't load since the game update","kind":"noload","text":"It worked yesterday.","zip":"team"}, zip (file, the report zip)

post.title: Mods don't load since the game update

endpoints.notes: draft: title 3-90 characters (one line); kind noload|mod|crash|launcher|server|other; when (optional) start|menu|load|play|join|other; text up to 1500 characters; zip team|public|none (default team); known (optional) the id of the known problem the player saw. With zip none, send report.json alone as the part report (a file) instead of zip. The request is at most 9 MiB, the zip at most 8 MiB.

endpoints.name: send a report, not in the server
send a report, account under 3 days old
send a report, not one of our zips
send a report, zip too big
send a report, too many this hour
send a report, Discord not answering
your posts

posts.title: Mods don't load since the game update

endpoints.notes: Newest first, at most 200. Ask when the page opens and every 5 minutes.

post.title: Mods don't load since the game update

endpoints.name: It's fixed

post.title: Mods don't load since the game update

endpoints.notes: Adds the Solved tag on Discord. No body.

endpoints.name: Delete my post
endpoints.notes: Deletes the post on Discord and the team's copy of its zip. If Discord is down, the post leaves the list at once and is deleted on Discord as soon as it answers.

endpoints.name: news and events (public)
endpoints.notes: The last three releases and the server's scheduled and running events. Cached 10 minutes (Cache-Control: public, max-age=300). No sign-in.

endpoints.name: known problems (public)

issues.title: Night Sky and Weather Plus crash together

endpoints.notes: From the support session's known-issues.json, entries checked (docs/relay-api.md, Known problems). An entry: id, title, fix, optional copy or action {label, to}, match {findings, text, os, kiln {min, max}}, notice, added, until. Entries past until are left out.

endpoints.name: volunteer as a tester
endpoints.notes: Gives the Tester role at once. Each hardware field is one line of at most 120 characters (gpu required); covers at most 8 items. beta (optional) is accepted and not kept. Calling it again replaces the hardware.

endpoints.name: send test results
endpoints.request: multipart/form-data: results (JSON) {"build":"0.2.0-dev.30","steps":[{"id":"fsr4","title":"Turn on FSR 4","result":"failed","note":"Water smears"}]}, zip (optional file: a report zip for the team)
endpoints.notes: steps: 1 to 40, each id (lower case), title (up to 100), result worked|failed|skipped, note (optional, up to 200). Sending again for the same build replaces the earlier message (and its read mark).

endpoints.name: test results for a build without a #testing post
tester state with a read mark
stop testing
endpoints.notes: Removes the Tester role, the hardware and the results list (the messages in #testing stay).

endpoints.name: sign out and forget me (and delete my posts)
endpoints.notes: Without posts=1 the posts stay on Discord (their zips are still deleted at once). Ends every session of the player.

endpoints.name: health
endpoints.notes: gateway: ready | connecting | off. version: the deployed commit.
